PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Deutsche Bank India — Assistant Vice President June 2023 – June 2026 Enterprise Data Governance, Data Quality & Control Assurance
Data Governance & KPI Validation 
Led independent KPI validation and Data Quality Framework assessments, improving data integrity, accuracy, completeness, and alignment with Enterprise Data Governance standards. Performed end-to-end Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of Data Controls, strengthening Governance Compliance and enterprise control assurance. Identified data quality issues, governance risks, and reporting inconsistencies, enabling timely remediation and improving governance accountability across business functions


Delivered independent validation findings, governance risk insights, and remediation recommendations, supporting informed
decision-making and continuous improvement
Governed remediation lifecycle activities, partnering with stakeholders to improve governance accountability, control
effectiveness, and timely issue resolution. Produced executive governance reporting highlighting Data Integrity trends, governance risks, control performance, and remediation progress for senior leadership. Standardized Enterprise Data Governance practices by strengthening KPI definitions, Data Quality Frameworks, and Data Controls across business divisions. Regulatory Adherence & Policy Governance  Conducted Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) adherence reviews, validating governance requirements for Critical


Data Elements (CDEs) and identifying governance gaps to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and Governance Compliance.
Verified Data Steward assignments within Collibra, confirming active stewardship and governance accountability in support of

Core Data Management Standards (CDMS) compliance. Performed Governance Risk Assessments by evaluating adherence to Data Management Policies, Minimum Control Standards (MCS), and enterprise governance requirements.
Aligned Data Controls with regulatory requirements and enterprise governance standards, improving governance maturity and

audit readiness. Produced audit-ready Regulatory Evidence Management documentation, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely regulatory submissions.
Recommended remediation strategies that strengthened Governance Compliance, Data Integrity, and Enterprise Data

Governance practices. Led annual regulatory inventory recertification, maintaining governance compliance across enterprise data assets. Facilitated governance awareness sessions to promote Data Stewardship, governance accountability, and adoption of Enterprise Data Governance standards.
Stakeholder Management & Governance Leadership 
Partnered with Technology, Risk, Compliance, Operations, Data Stewards, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen Enterprise Data Governance and improve governance accountability.
 Collaborated with senior stakeholders to resolve governance risks, prioritize remediation activities, and enhance Governance
Compliance across strategic initiatives.
Acted as the primary governance contact for leadership forums, presenting governance insights, Data Integrity metrics, and

remediation progress. Led governance working groups that improved Data Stewardship practices, reduced reporting inconsistencies, and strengthened governance accountability across business functions.
People Management & Team Leadership 
Provided functional leadership and mentoring to junior analysts, strengthening governance capability, reporting quality, and process adherence. Support onboarding, training, and capability building, improving team productivity and consistency in governance deliverables
 Review and quality assure deliverables (dashboards, reports, validation outputs), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment to leadership expectations
Drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and control awareness within the team and across delivery
stakeholders
Collaborate across teams to prioritize workload, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of critical governance
outputs
Portfolio Governance, Reporting & Automation  
Lead Clarity PPM governance, ensuring accuracy of delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, forecasts, and RAID data. Performed structured Data Quality Framework assessments across portfolio reporting, validating milestones, RAID logs, dependencies, and delivery forecasts to improve Data Integrity.
Drive disciplined governance routines, embedding standardized reporting cycles and data accountability across teams.  Own and enhance Milestone Roadmap dashboards, improving visibility of delivery risks, slippage, and dependencies.  Delivered executive governance dashboards and portfolio health insights, enabling proactive risk identification and informed decision-making.
Validated GFMS actions, RAG status changes, governance narratives, and Data Controls, ensuring reporting accuracy,
governance compliance, and audit readiness. Implement automation for reporting and action tracking, improving traceability, efficiency, and audit readiness.
 Build SAP BI reporting solutions, enhancing data visualization, reporting quality, and process efficiency.  Leverage AI (Copilot) for reporting automation, improving productivity and standardization of outputs.
JPMorgan Chase & Co.— Various Roles June 2009 – June 2023 Data Governance, Privacy, Controls & Risk Management  Governed data privacy frameworks, including DPIA approvals, DSIR processing, and regulatory compliance.  Maintained Records of Processing Inventory (ROPI) aligned to GDPR and global privacy standards.  Delivered privacy governance reporting and insights to senior stakeholders and forums.  Risk, Controls & Governance  Conducted QA reviews of control frameworks, improving quality, consistency, and risk transparency.   Records, Resiliency & Access Governance  Managed records lifecycle governance, ensuring compliance with retention, legal, and regulatory standards.  Delivered business continuity and resiliency governance, including testing, reporting, and plan validation.  Governed identity & access management controls, ensuring compliance with SOD and access control policies.
Performed root cause analysis on data incidents, strengthening preventive control mechanisms.
Strengthened policy adherence, SOP governance, and control documentation frameworks. Supported audit readiness and control enhancement initiatives across business units.
